title: Bound the tetrad alphabet's exhibited effective rank
body:
## Summary
- The one-sided tetrad-local alphabet has copy floor 112 and term rank at most 4. Its completed identities have effective ranks 2 and 1.
- The ideal rank-2 screen of the selected local mass stays under a 5% gain. The rank-4 screen clears that gain as the term-cap relaxation, and the note does not exhibit that identity.
- Partial bound only. No new kappa and no decoder search.

## Test plan
